messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | Tant' | “so” (intensifier) | இவ்வளவு | “so much” | OK | | è | copular “is” (1st occurrence) | உள்ளது | “is” | OK | | amara | “bitter” | கசப்பாக | “bitterly” | OK | | che | conjunction “that” (introduces comparative clause) | மற்றும் | “and” | **WRONG** (should be “என்று” or similar) | | poco | adverb of degree “little” | கொஞ்சம் | “a little” | OK | | è | copular “is” (2nd occurrence) | உள்ளது | “is” | OK | | più | comparative “more” | அதிகமாக | “more” | OK | | morte | noun “death” | மரணம் | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating “but” | ஆனால் | “but” | OK | | per | preposition of purpose “for / in order to” | பேசுவதற்காக | “in order to speak” | OK | | trattar | infinitive “to treat / discuss” | பேசுவது | “to speak / discuss” | OK | | del | “of the” (preposition + article) | நல்லதைப் | “the good (obj.)” | OK | | ben | noun “good” | நல்லதை | “good” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun + subject “that I” | நான் | “I” | OK | | vi | adverb “there” (locative) | அங்கே | “there” | OK | | trovai | 1st‑person past “found” | கண்ட | “found” | OK | | dirò | 1st‑person future “I will say” | சொல்லுவேன் | “I will tell” | OK | | de | preposition “of” | மற்றவற்றைச் | “of the other things” | OK | | l'altre | adjective “the other” | மற்றவற்றை | “the other” | OK | | cose | noun “things” | மற்றவற்றை | “things” | OK | | ch'i' (2nd) | relative pronoun + subject “that I” | நான் | “I” | OK | | v'ho | auxiliary “have” (perfect) | பார்த்த | “have seen / saw” | OK | | scorte | past participle “seen” | பார்த்த | “seen” | OK |
---
### Issues Detected - **WRONG:** *che* was rendered as **மற்றும்** (“and”), which does not convey the comparative “that” meaning. A more appropriate Tamil connective would be **என்று** or **அதனால்**.
No other source words are missing, and no grammatical agreement errors were found in the Tamil rendering. No unnecessary elements from the source were retained in the target.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 7: - Original: அது இவ்வளவு கசப்பாக உள்ளது மற்றும் மரணம் அதைவிட கொஞ்சம் அதிகமாக உள்ளது; - Issue: **WRONG** – the connective “che” was rendered as “மற்றும்” (and) instead of a comparative/resultative connector; also internal punctuation is avoided. - Corrected: அது இவ்வளவு கசப்பாக உள்ளது என்று மரணம் அதைவிட கொஞ்சம் அதிகமாக உள்ளது;
- Line 8: - Original: ஆனால் நான் அங்கே கண்ட நல்லதைப் பற்றி பேசுவதற்காக, - Issue: none - Corrected: இல்லை (no change)
- Line 9: - Original: நான் அங்கே பார்த்த மற்றவற்றைச் சொல்லுவேன். - Issue: none - Corrected: இல்லை (no change)
``` அது இவ்வளவு கசப்பாக உள்ளது என்று மரணம் அதைவிட கொஞ்சம் அதிகமாக உள்ளது; ஆனால் நான் அங்கே கண்ட நல்லதைப் பற்றி பேசுவதற்காக, நான் அங்கே பார்த்த மற்றவற்றைச் சொல்லுவேன். ```
